title: Everyday Phrases — Buying a Plane Ticket Online
scene_zh: 網上買機票 · 情境對話
title_quote: I need to book a flight online.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】✈️ 實用在網上買機票必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Buying a Plane Ticket Online
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用在網上買機票的情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從搜尋航班、比較直飛與轉機、看票價與行李額度，到填寫乘客資料、選座位、加購行李、輸入優惠碼與刷卡付款，再到行程單核對、改簽退票規則、線上值機選座位，最後還有航班延誤通知、改期退款、抵用券與里程積分。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Buying a Plane Ticket Online phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). From searching flights, comparing nonstop with connections and reading fares and baggage limits, to entering passenger details, picking seats, adding bags, applying a promo code and paying by card, then checking the itinerary, change and refund rules, online check-in and seat maps, and finally delay alerts, rebooking, refunds, vouchers and frequent-flyer miles. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need to book a flight online.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid tu bʊk ə flaɪt ˈɔnˌlaɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which city are you flying to?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you want a round trip?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I fly back on Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's open a flight search site.
dialogue.zh: 我們打開一個航班搜尋網站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 買之前先比較兩個網站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I search one airport only?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不用，也把附近的機場加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個篩選條件是直飛航班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 直飛就是中途不停，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, but they cost a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt bʌt ðeɪ kɔst ə bɪt mɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 是的，我到那邊換一架飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 轉機時間要仔細看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd avoid such a short gap.
dialogue.zh: 這麼短的間隔我會避開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But I hate waking up early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那天有晚一點的班機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不過那個時間比較舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sort the results by price?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɔrt ðə rɪˈsʌlts baɪ praɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the cheap ones show first.
dialogue.zh: 現在便宜的都排在前面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's look for the luggage rules.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有些網站會加收訂票費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 所以最後付的數字才算數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The same flight costs less here.
dialogue.zh: 同一班在這裡比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I turn on price alerts?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they email when it drops.
dialogue.zh: 對，價格一降就會發郵件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一般週中的航班便宜些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app shows this in dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以改用其他貨幣計價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過我還是用美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which one is the better deal?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cheapest fare has no refund.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 要是計畫變了就麻煩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can change dates for free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My plans are set for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a passport now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在就要護照資料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some countries want six more months.
dialogue.zh: 有些國家要求多六個月效期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 先把這個航班收藏起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, now I can find it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ aɪ kæn faɪnd ɪt fæst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want me to watch the price?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please check the same route tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 明天請再看同一條航線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 座位圖能看出靠窗的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I always pick a window seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aisle seats are easier to leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This plane has no middle option?
dialogue.zh: 這架飛機沒有中間座位？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So every row is just two?
dialogue.zh: 所以每一排只有兩個座位？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a meal on this flight?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the flight time?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me write these details down.
dialogue.zh: 我先把這些細節寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then compare with the other site.
dialogue.zh: 然後再跟另一個網站比。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的護照已經辦好延期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enter your name like your passport.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says last name first here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it in the middle box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does she have her own seat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pick two seats side by side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pɪk tu sits saɪd baɪ saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那就選兩個相鄰的座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll select this pair right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free seats are at the back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 後面的座位其實也很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take the free ones today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart way to save some cash.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many suitcases do we have?
dialogue.zh: 我們總共有幾個行李箱？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add them both to the order.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只有生病的情況才會理賠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it worth the extra cost?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a flyer number?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you want the miles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My number is on my card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 輸入時中間不要留空格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把信箱裡的優惠碼貼上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says the code is expired.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No luck, I'll pay full price.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My credit card gives travel points.
dialogue.zh: 我的信用卡有旅行點數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, so it's still a win.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's more than the search price.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 付費座位被偷偷加回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But you picked the free ones.
dialogue.zh: 可你選的不是免費座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can drop the paid seats.
dialogue.zh: 我可以把付費座位拿掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay with a debit card?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ wɪð ə ˈdɛbɪt kɑrd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if it has a Visa mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪf ɪt hæz ə ˈvizə mɑrk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 看一下帳單地址填對了沒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, I typed the old zip code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ aɪ taɪpt ði oʊld zɪp koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 啊，我填了舊的郵遞區號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fix it and try once more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet, the page is loading.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My email is the work address.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change it to your personal one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I change that after paying?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually yes, from the booking page.
dialogue.zh: 通常可以，在訂票頁面裡改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get a calendar invite?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll need the booking for my visa.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl nid ðə ˈbʊkɪŋ fər maɪ ˈvizə/
dialogue.zh: 我辦簽證要用這個訂票記錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把機票和行程單印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 航空公司會傳簡訊給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Create an account to manage trips.
dialogue.zh: 註冊一個帳號管理行程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the app saves your details.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the price get charged today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your card shows it now.
dialogue.zh: 對，你的卡上已經看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now watch for the confirmation email.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it and check the flight number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt ænd tʃɛk ðə flaɪt ˈnʌmbər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says flight two one seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I edit the name myself?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, call the airline support line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small fix beats buying again.
dialogue.zh: 小改一下比重新買划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, now the ticket is valid.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，現在這張票有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gates can change at the airport.
dialogue.zh: 到了機場登機口還會變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a booking reference here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡有訂票參考編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's the six letters again.
dialogue.zh: 有，就是剛才那六個字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it saved on your phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look for the fare conditions section.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A pricier new flight costs more.
dialogue.zh: 新航班較貴就要多付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 稅金那部分說不定能退。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You file it after the trip.
dialogue.zh: 旅程結束後再提交申請就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I'm sick that day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有醫生的證明會比較有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們會改發旅行額度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 常見是給一年份的額度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Travel credit is easy to use.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can book a later trip.
dialogue.zh: 可以拿它訂之後的行程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 太好了，線上報到開放了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can also print it out.
dialogue.zh: 你也可以把它列印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my seat still the window?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's look at the seat map.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 換機型時常發生這種事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, free seats are still open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 第十八排看起來比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 趕在被人挑走前先選它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, I sit by the exit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move her row next to you.
dialogue.zh: 把她調到你隔壁那一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在我們又坐在一起了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I still drop my bags?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bags go at the counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours before an international flight.
dialogue.zh: 國際班機要提前兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to print anything?
dialogue.zh: 我需要列印什麼東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your passport and pass are enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many bags can we carry on?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni bæɡz kæn wi ˈkæri ɑn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bag and one personal item.
dialogue.zh: 一件背包加一件個人物品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my purse a personal item?
dialogue.zh: 我的小包算個人物品嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if it fits under the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪf ɪt fɪts ˈʌndər ðə sit/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My liquids are in one bag.
dialogue.zh: 我的液體都裝在一個袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I show my pass twice?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once at security, once at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns æt sɪˈkjʊrəti wʌns æt ðə ɡeɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I change my seat at the gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tʃeɪndʒ maɪ sit æt ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 在登機口還能換座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if seats are still free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope the flight isn't full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Would you rather it be empty?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want an empty middle seat.
dialogue.zh: 我想要一個空的中間座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們改了我的起飛時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 航空公司允許免費改訂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I call or use the app?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kɔl ɔr juz ði æp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found one tomorrow at noon.
dialogue.zh: 我找到明天中午的一班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那配合你的會議時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check in again for the new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ˈɪn əˈɡɛn fər ðə nu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 為新航班要再報到一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the delay affect my bags?
dialogue.zh: 延誤會影響我的行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to recheck them?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I get a meal voucher?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They gave me a shuttle pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That takes you to the hotel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They cancelled my return flight too.
dialogue.zh: 他們把我的回程航班也取消了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get my money refunded?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does a refund take?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Refund to the card or wallet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把那封信再仔細看一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep a copy of their reply.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Miles still fly on a new ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪlz stɪl flaɪ ɑn ə nu ˈtɪkɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, or my status would drop.
dialogue.zh: 幸好，不然會員等級會掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I earn more miles now?
dialogue.zh: 這樣會多積一些里程嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's close to a free ticket.
dialogue.zh: 那快能換一張免費票了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use miles for a seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juz maɪlz fər ə sit/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do miles expire after two years?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有些計畫要求每年有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll book a short trip soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A friend asked for a booking tip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə frɛnd æskt fər ə ˈbʊkɪŋ tɪp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還有別買不可退票的票價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should she pay for bags online?
dialogue.zh: 她該在網上先買行李額度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also join the airline email list.
dialogue.zh: 也要訂閱航空公司的信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 會員會早一點看到特賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app showed me the sale.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm grabbing one for next spring.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The trip is cheaper by half.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still need a seat choice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 免費座位報到時才開放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wait for a better price?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ weɪt fər ə ˈbɛtər praɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if your dates stay open.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then book it while it's low.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it next to the other trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ɪt nɛkst tu ði ˈʌðər trɪp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both trips are set, so rest easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ trɪps ər sɛt soʊ rɛst ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 兩趟都安排好了，安心休息吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love booking my own tickets.
